package.name: so100_cell_interfaces
package.description: The typed surface between a supervisor (or an agent) and the cell: a correlated IK request and its result, and the ownership/lease request that the per-arm port already implements over HTTP. Chapter 2 of the MCP specification asks for a Humble interface package; this is it, and it exists so that "which target does this solution answer?" has a field to live in instead of an assumption.
